clearance.note: CL/kg = 0.058 L/h/kg published; 0.058*1000/60 = 0.97 mL/min/kg. True systemic clearance (IV). An alternative NCA estimate of 7.26 L/h (Yau 2023, PMID 36647756) = 1.73 mL/min/kg at 70 kg; both indicate a low-clearance drug (~1-2 mL/min/kg).
